title: How to Play GTA 6 on PC: What Actually Works Right Now (and What's a Scam)
seoTitle: How to Play GTA 6 on PC: Remote Play, Cloud and Scams
seoDescription: GTA 6 has no PC version yet. Stream it to your PC from your own PS5 or Xbox with Remote Play; Xbox Cloud is console-only and PC downloads are scams.
excerpt: Set up PS Remote Play or Xbox remote play on a Windows PC, the internet speeds Sony and Xbox ask for, why cloud gaming won't work on PC, and how to spot fake GTA 6 PC downloads.
